response.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'WS') GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The NL and WS conditions must hold on the same batting_postseason record, so the subquery filters on both columns together. Only the player-selection step uses those filters; the triple total sums all of the player's postseason records in every league and round.
SUM ignores NULL triples, so a player whose triple values are all NULL gets a NULL total, which NULLS LAST places at the bottom. NULLS LAST requires SQLite 3.30+ or PostgreSQL.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, because the request does not specify a secondary sort key.
